Commentary.Commentary: So, the pitch isn't that bad as the batting scorecard suggests. England should fancy their chances to level the series. But given the way New Zealand fought back towards the end, will they be able to pull off something spectacular with the ball? We shall find out once the chase begins...

It was really a poor batting display from the Kiwis. Martin Guptill did manage to steady the ship but threw it away as soon as he reached his fifty. From thereon, the wickets kept tumbling which saw the hosts digging the yard for themselves. However, the star of the last game, Mitchell Santner came to the fore to save the blushes. He willingly spent some time in the middle and stroked his way to an unbeaten 63 off 52 balls. Also, not to forget Lockie Ferguson's effort who offered him a good hand as the duo stitched a crucial 69-run stand and helped their side recover a bit.

Excellent effort from England to restrict the hosts to a below par total. Chris Woakes dented the top order with some good bowling upfront only for the spinners to take care after that. Rashid and Ali were really disciplined in their respective spells, giving away just 65 in 20 overs combined. The latter did manage to pick up two while Stokes too got two to his name. Their bowlers were equally backed by their fielders who were just terrific today. Superb catches and run outs (4) tell us that they have redeemed themselves after being very ordinary in the first game.

OUT! That's it! NEW ZEALAND ARE STEAMROLLED FOR 223! Fuller in length and angling in, Santner drags it through mid-wicket and wants two immediately. Stokes comes running in from the deep, picks up the ball and throws it at the bowler's end where Woakes does well to collect and disturb the stumps. Boult was always struggling to get in and when it is sent upstairs, only one replay is enough for the TV umpire to rule him out.
Is that it? Another run out appeal has been taken upstairs.
Third man comes in, mid off drops back now.
FOUR! Mitchell Santner is playing a blinder here! Gets underneath a full ball and smacks it over mid off for a boundary.
Clever Chris! Rolls his fingers over the ball, keeps it full outside off. Santner shuffles to swing it across the line and is beaten completely due to the slowness on the ball.
Very full and fired outside off, Santner squeezes it back in the direction of Woakes.
Chris Woakes to bowl the final over. How much can NZ add? Santner on strike...
That was so, so close! Stokes pitches it right up there and it holds it lines too. Boult looks to defend but it just whizzes past the outside edge and nearly kisses the off pole.
Fuller in length outside off, sliced over cover for a couple.
Beaten! On a length outside off, Trent with no feet movement goes after it and gets beaten completely.
Trent Boult is the last man in.

OUT! Lockie Ferguson's cameo comes to an end! But he has given good support to Santner in the stand that was worth 69 runs! Backs away to a fuller ball and tries to slam it over mid off. Doesn't get it off the middle and ends up mistiming it towards Rashid in that region who takes a catch with a dive to his left.
Bowls an indipping yorker, jammed out to long on for a single.
Looks to clip it away but it goes off the pads towards the left of Buttler. They take a leg bye.

In the air... safe! Looks to make room and go over extra cover but doesn't time it well. Stokes from mid off runs backward but the ball lands safely. Two to end the expensive over of the innings so far, 19 off it!
FOUR! Ahhh, all timing! Curran is taken to the cleaners! Serves a fuller ball on middle, Mitchell just lifts it straight back down the ground.

SIX! My word, that's murdered! What a way to bring up your maiden ODI fifty! Just to remind you it's his 50th ODI game and he has made it a special one for him by playing such a valuable knock. Fuller in length and on the pads, Santner clears the front leg and dumps it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum all the way.
Bowls a cutter, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! Bludgeoned! Meaty blow! Enough of singles and doubles says Lockie and gets into the action now. Short ball outside off, Lockie Ferguson stays back and fetches it from there. Makes immense connection to bring up the 200 as well as the 50-run stand between the two.
Bangs in a short ball on middle and leg, Lockie initially looks to pull but sees the ball bouncing a touch more and hence at the last moment he ducks.
On middle and leg, nudged through mid-wicket for a single. The stand is worth 48 off 58 balls now.
Covers the line and defends it back to Stokes.
Tempts him with a slower ball outside off, Ferguson tries going after it and gets foxed.
Fuller ball outside off, drilled past cover. One run added to the total.
Angling in on a back of a length, Lockie hops back and tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
Shortish ball outside off, Santner cuts it off the outer half towards third man. They run one and Ferguson comes in search of another. Seeing Willey get to the ball, Santner sends him back in time.
Fuller ball on the stumps, kept out safely by Lockie.
A bit too full on leg, wristed towards long on for one.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Short ball, but it's wide outside off, left alone.
Doles out a full toss, angling in, Ferguson looks to swing across the line but misses and wears it on the pads.
Starts off with a slower delivery on off, pushed off the front foot towards point.
FOUR! Powerful! Angling away on a length, wider outside off, Santner gets back and smashes it through cover to end the over with a boundary. Moves into the 40s with that!
Fuller delivery on leg, Santner backs away and pulls it through mid-wicket. The throw from the deep is not that great which allows the pair to take a couple.
Worked wide of the man at mid on for a single.
Fuller ball outside off, Lockie swings and misses.
Another chance of a run out! Santner taps it in front of point and sets off. Roy gets to the ball but fails to collect it cleanly. Ferguson gets back home safely.
Ben Stokes lands it on a length around off and angles it away, Santner lunges ahead to defend but fails to get any bat. That just whizzed past the outside edge.
A bouncer outside off, the batsman evades it.
Length delivery around off, played to point.
Nice slower ball on off, Ferguson waits for it and drives it to mid off.
Short and wide outside off, Santner cuts it behind point and down to third man for a run.
Slower short ball on middle, Ferguson mistimes his pull towards square leg for a run.
Lands it on a length around off, Ferguson defends it solidly.
Drops it short on the stumps, MS pulls it nicely but finds the man at short mid-wicket.
FOUR! That will do for Mitchell! Stokes angles it away on a length outside off, Santner tries to force it through the line but gets it off the bottom edge down to third man for a streaky boundary.
Slower ball, on a fuller length, LF drills it through cover for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Lockie taps it in front of cover.
Leg stump line, clipped fine down the leg side for a single.
Another good stop from Roy! Slower ball from Stokes, Santner waits back and then cuts it hard. Jason at point dives to his left to stop a certain boundary.
Ben Stokes comes back to bowl now.

A loud shout for an LBW! Tom Curran bowls an inswinging yorker, Lockie tries jamming it out and nearly falls over while doing so. It goes off his pads towards fine leg and they are busy crossing. Tom keeps appealing but it's turned down by the umpire as it seemed like heading down leg.
Rolls his fingers over the ball, Santner clears his front leg to pull it along the ground through mid-wicket for a single.
A bit short and outside off, slapped through cover for one.
Wide! Curran bends his back and hits the deck hard. Ferguson is quick to duck under it. The umpire stretches his hands to call it a wide.
On a good length and just outside off, Lockie shoulders his arms.
Takes the pace off and hurls it on a fuller in length, hit down to long on for one.
On a shorter length o middle and leg, Mitchell pulls through backward square leg and picks up two before Stokes mops it up in the deep.
A dot to finish the spell. Good one from Rashid. He ends with figures of 10-0-32-0! Quicker one on middle, punched back to the leggie.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Sees the flight does Santner and gets down. Sweeps it between deep mid-wicket and square leg to find the fence.
Flatter outside off, punched by making some room towards extra cover.
Turning in on middle, defended down gently.

Was there a nick? Oh yes! Rashid drifts it down leg, Ferguson looks to clip it away and it goes off something off Buttler's gloves towards short fine leg. Umpire Tucker doesn't signal it as a bye. It was off the edge.
Stump-to-stump line, MS blocks it from within the crease.
Fuller and angling in on a fuller length, Ferguson is late in bringing his bat down. Gets it off the inside edge through square leg for a single.
Stays back and offers a tight defense.
Chips this fuller ball and luckily for him it falls well short of Bairstow who is running in from deep mid-wicket. Only a single.
Wide! Curran does what any fast bowler would do after getting hit over  a boundary. He bangs in a short one but it goes well over Santner's head and a wide is rightly called.
FOUR! Nailed it! On a length around middle, Mitchell Santner waits on the back foot and through his strong wrists his whips it flat through mid-wicket. A boundary results!
Angles it away on the fifth stump line. Santner makes an easy leave.
Tom Curran is recalled into the attack.
Fuller in length again, pushed off the outer half towards point.
Slower through the air, landing full around off, Ferguson doesn't fall in the trap. He defends.
Stays back and keeps it out.
Flatter one on the stumps, Santner makes a bit of room as he punches it down to long off for one.
Bowls a loopy full toss on middle, pulled away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated delivery on the stumps, defended into the ground.
Adil Rashid is back on.
Dropped short again, punched towards sweeper cover to bring the 150 up for NZ. With that Ali is done for the day with figures of 10-0-33-2! Superb from Mo!
Flattish ball outside off, punched off the back foot towards point.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
On middle and leg, worked through square leg by Lockie for one.
Lockie Ferguson is the new man in.

OUT! Third run out of the innings! Poor cricket from New Zealand! Santner works it towards Stokes at short mid-wicket who fumbles and seeing that Santner calls through for a single. Southee is busy ball-watching and eventually starts to run. Ben Stokes quickly recovers and hurls a throw at the striker's end to find Southee well short. This is getting over all too early.
Sliding in with the arm, blocked out back towards Ali.
Slaps it over cover-point and collects a brace.
The batsman has done well to keep that yorker at bay.

FOUR! Edged and Southee gets off the mark! Woakes lands it on a length and it moves away a bit to square the Kiwi skipper up. Tim has a poke at it, gets an edge wide of the slip fielder for a boundary.
The skipper, Tim Southee makes his way out to the middle next.

OUT! Colin de Grandhomme is out of here! Jonny Bairstow is really pumped up. I will tell you why. On the previous ball the batsman took him on and ran two. Once again Colin de Grandhomme hops and tucks it through square leg and calls for another couple. However, Jonny is quick to attack the ball this time and return a flat throw to Buttler who takes the bails off quickly. They take it upstairs and replays find Bairstow winning the battle this time.
Colin de Grandhomme seems to be struggling here. He hasn't made it in reckon England and put in a huge appeal. The third umpire is asked for some assistance...
Wants two and gets it! Tucks it through square leg does de Grandhomme and takes Bairstow on who was a bit slow to attack. Two runs completed.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, tucked through square leg for a single.
Loopy ball around middle, eased down towards long on to keep strike.
Finally pierces the gap. Gets to the other end by driving it through cover.
Pushed once again towards the same fielder whop stops it with a dive to his right to deny them a run.
Another delivery fired outside off, de Grandhomme punches it off the back foot and finds the fielder in the same region.
Quicker ball outside off, punched off the back foot towards the cover fielder.
Fires it in and cramping Santner for room who moves leg side and manages to punch it down to long on. A single taken.
Drinks are on the field!
FOUR! How easy did he make it look? Gets a fuller ball and just lofts it over mid on. Amazing connection behind the shot and de Grandhomme picks up his fourth boundary. Moves to 34 off 34 balls.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Whippy pull! Digs in a short ball, angling in, Santner whips it aerially over mid-wicket. Another good stop in the deep by the fielder. They take three more.
Angling away on a length outside off, stabbed out towards point.
Another fuller ball on off, driven through the same region for another single.
Bowls a fuller ball outside off, Santner drives it towards cover for a single.
Chris Woakes is back into the attack. He dented the top order. Can he wrap it up quickly? 5-1-18-2 read his figures!
Pushed down to long on for an easy single.
Hangs back and defends it down.
Clipped towards mid-wicket for nothing.

Floated ball outside off, Mitchell looks to drive but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls towards point. The throw from the fielder is a wayward one at the bowler's end which allows them to take another.
Pushes it quicker through the air.
Darted on middle and leg, wristed straight to mid on.
Looks to drive it away but gets it off the inner half towards mid on.
Flatter through the air, Colin leans ahead and defends.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Blocks it out off the front foot again.
On middle and off, defended off the front foot gently.

Safely home! Santner drives this tossed up delivery towards mid off and calls for a single. Woakes picks up the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. It's taken upstairs but Mitchell has made it in.
Direct hit and we have another run out appeal sent upstairs. Mitchell Santner seems to be home though.
Once again drives it straight to the man at cover.
Leans forward to drive but can't find the gap.

FOUR! Edgyyy! Ali pushes it through the air outside off, Colin de Grandhomme throws his hands at it. Gets it off the edge wide of the keeper and David Willey tries his best from short third man to stop it but comes second best.
Bowls it a touch wider on off, MS drives it towards long off for one.
Floated delivery around middle and off, Santner blocks it out.
Tossed up ball outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
Presses forward and offers a tight defense.
Milks a single down to long on for a single.
Around middle and leg, worked off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Santner opens the face of the bat and runs it down behind point for one.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! A gift to start the spell! New Zealand need those in plenty! Short ball down the leg side, de Grandhomme gets inside the line and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Mitchell Santner is the next man in. He played a handy cameo to see his side home in the first game. Can he bail his side out of trouble today? Also, Adil Rashid comes back on.

OUT! Tom Latham perishes as well! The procession continues for the hosts. A nothing delivery from Ali. He drops it flat and short on off, Tom gets back to slash this but there is a tinge of extra bounce which brings his downfall. Gets an edge which flies into the bucket-like hands of Tom Curran stationed at short third man. Second wicket for Moeen Ali.
Goes back and punches it towards the cover fielder.
Reaches out to a tossed up ball and drives it down the ground to get to the other end.
Floated delivery on middle and leg, eased down to long on for a single.
A bit flatter, slapped square on the off side for one.
Darts it fuller on off, driven straight to extra cover.
Angling away on a length outside off, left alone by Tom.
Leg bye! Brings it back into the batsman, Colin misses his tuck and gets it off the pads towards square leg.

SIX! That's gone the distance! What a hit! Stokes digs in a short ball, angling in on middle, de Grandhomme stands put and thwacks it over backward square leg for the first maximum of the game. The fielder there did leap but the ball sailed well over him and into the fence. Also, 100 comes up for NZ!
Latham presses forward to a full ball and strokes it towards mid off for a brisk single. There was a shy made at the bowler's end b the fielder but he misses.

Finds the gap! Just a check-drive! On a length outside off, Colin leans a bit and drives it through cover. Rashid hares after the ball and does well to dive and scoop the ball back in play. By the time he does, the batsmen take three.
Fuller in length and served just outside off, driven on the up towards cover.
Looks to drive it through the line but gets it off the inner half past Latham at the other end. They take a single as the ball rolls down to long on.
Another one on a similar length, punched once again towards the cover fielder off the back foot.
Quicker and turning back in from over the wicket, punched straight to the cover fielder.
Flatter ball on middle, Tom punches it down to long on for another single.
Quicker through the air outside off, de Grandhomme drives it through point for a single.
Latham uses his feet and wrists it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Much-needed one! Short and on middle, Colin de Grandhomme gets on top of the bounce and pulls it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary to end the over.
Back of a length on off, defended.
Nicely bowled! Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. Colin plays down the wrong line and is beaten.
A bumper on middle, Latham mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, cut to point.
On a length around off, Latham chops it to the keeper.
Flatter on off, defended.
Pushes it down to long on for a run.
Latham comes down the track. Seeing that Moeen Shortens his length. Tom defends it.
Flatter on off, defended.
Tosses it up outside off, driven through covers for a run.
Works it with the angle through square leg for a run.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
BEATEN! Excellent delivery! On a length around off, shapes away a touch. De Grandhomme tries to defend but gets beaten.
Colin de Grandhomme walks out to the middle.

OUT! Ho! Ho! Ho! Jason Roy, you beauty! Whattteeeeyyy catch! He took a stunner in the previous over to dismiss Guptill and this time he has bettered that effort. WOW! A short ball outside off, it sat up to be hit and Nicholls does exactly that. He cuts it hard towards Roy at point who throws himself to his right and plucks it out in a stunning fashion. Mind you, that was struck really, really hard. Nicholls can't believe his luck, looks up and trudges back. England are all over New Zealand here as the hosts have now lost half their side and haven't reached the three-figure mark as yet.
Another length ball outside off, Latham guides it down to third man for another run.
Short ball, pulled straight to fine leg for a run.
On a length around off, guided down to third man for a run.
Floats it up on off, kept out.
Henry Nicholls walks out at no. 6.

OUT! Caught! Another exceptional work in the field by an English player. This time it is Roy who takes a really good catch. Ali tosses it up on off, Guptill slog sweeps it really hard but does not keep it down. It goes towards Jason at deep mid-wicket who runs to his right, dives and takes it inches above the ground. The opener departs immediately after he reaches his fifty. Guptill walks back dejected putting his side further on the back foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shortish outside off, cut to point.
Dances down the track and pushes it down to long off for a run.

Fifty for Guptill this time. His 34th in this format. It has been a very watchful innings by him. He though has to stay there till the end if New Zealand are to reach to a respective total. He works it down to long on for a run to reach that milestone.
Good length outside off, defended.
Fifty for Guptill? No, not yet! He clips it away towards square leg and gets to the other end. However, the umpire signals it as a leg bye.
In the air... but short again! Stokes bowls a bumper on middle, Latham goes for the pull but gets a top edge which goes on the bounce to Moeen Ali at fine leg.
On a length around off, defended towards point.
A short ball aimed at the rib cage of the batsman. Guptill works it down to fine leg. He calls two but the second is not on.
Back of a length on off, guided down to third man for an easy run.
Ben Stokes is into the attack.
Shortish outside off, cut straight to David Willey and there is no passing him today.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back.
Fires it on off, Guptill plays it towards point. The batsmen think about a run but then opt against it.
Flatter on off, defended.
Flatter on middle, Latham punches it to long on to change strike.
Fuller on off, pushed down to long on for a run.
Floats it up on off, defended.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.

Short ball, a half-tracker. Latham pulls it hard but straight to the man at deep mid-wicket for a run. Latham will be disappointed he could not get more out of that. There was one man in the deep on the leg side and he hit it straight to him.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! A freebie, a full toss on leg stump. Latham flicks it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Goes for the sweep but misses to get hit high on the pads. The players make a muted appeal but the umpire remains put.
Comes down the track and works it around the corner for a run.
Flatter on middle, pushed to mid-wicket.
Eases it down to long on for a run.
Tosses it up on middle, driven down to long on for a run.
Flatter on off, pushed through covers for a run.
Very full on off, driven to covers.
Spin from both ends! Moeen Ali is brought into the attack.
Loopy ball on off, defended. Another tight over by Rashid, his figures now read 5-0-10-0.
The wrong one on off, defended.
Pushes it to mid-wicket with the turn.
Nicely played! Fires it on off, Guptill waits for it and guides it towards third man but only for a run.
Flatter worked to mid-wicket.
Floats it up on off, Latham taps it towards cover for a run.
Another length ball on off, Guptill is solid in defense.
Good length on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Down the leg side and the umpire signals a wide.
A bouncer on middle, Guptill ducks under it.
Length on off, pushed to mid off.
Back of a length on off, guided towards point.
Fuller outside off, driven through covers to get off the mark.
Driven through mid off by the batsman.
Flatter on the stumps, Guptill defends it.
FOUR! Bad ball and dispatched! Short and wide outside off, Guptill cuts it late through short third man and the ball races away.
Gives it air on off, driven to covers.
Floats it up on middle, pushed to mid on.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Back of a length on off, played towards point for a run.
Good length on off, kept out.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Poor by Curran, he bowls it down the leg side. Guptill won't miss out on those as he flicks it fine down the leg side for a boundary to bring the fifty up for his side.
A good bouncer on middle, surprises Guptill but he does well to evade it.
Good length on off, defended.
Floats it on off, defended. Another fabulous over from Rashid, he has been top notch today.
Tom Latham walks out to the middle.

OUT! Taylor continues to walk! It's that man, David Willey at it again. He took an excellent catch early on to send Chapman back and now has inflicted a superb run out. Rashid bowls the wrong one around off on the shorter side. Taylor rocks back and cuts it towards backward point. He feels that he has found the gap and starts running. He however, has not as Willey there dives to his left and stops it with one hand. Seeing that effort, Guptill sends Taylor back who now has to turn and get back in time. Willey in the meanwhile fires a throw to the keeper who whips the bails off and appeals. The umpire takes it upstairs and replays show that the dive by Taylor has not saved him. So, the centurion in the last game departs cheaply today. Timely wicket for England as this partnership was starting to build.
Is Taylor a goner? He is walking off as there is a referral for a run out against him at the striker's end.
On the bounce to the fielder! Guptill goes for the sweep shot but the ball bounces a touch more. It takes the top edge and goes on the bounce to the deep square leg fielder for a run.
Floats it up on leg stump, pushed back to the bowler.
Short and wide outside off, Guptill can't find the gap as he cuts it hard towards cover-point.
Tosses it up on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Length ball outside off, pushed through covers for a run.
Fullish on middle, Taylor pushes it towards wide mid on where the fielder makes a good diving stop to his right but can't stop a single.
On the middle, worked towards wide mid on for a run.
On the pads, worked around the corner for a run.
On middle, Guptill gets it off the inner half towards square leg to change strike.
Fullish on off, driven to mid off.
Just one from the over! On the stumps, worked against the spin to mid-wicket.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Loopy ball on off, Taylor defends it towards cover. Guptill wants a run but there was never one in it.
BEATEN! Bowls the flipper outside off, on a shorter length. Taylor rocks back and tries to cut but does not connect.
Gives it air on off, Taylor defends it.
Pushed down to long off for a run.

Fullish on middle, trying to hit the pads of the batsman. He however, manages to flick it through backward square leg. Taylor runs the first one hard and seeing Rashid in the deep, he calls for another. Adil throws it towards the keeper but it is not a good one and the batsmen complete two.
Shorter in length around off, Taylor guides it to point.
Good length on off, Guptill pushes it towards cover for a run.
On middle, worked with the angle towards deep mid-wicket for an easy run. 29 is what the stand is between the two.
On off, pushed towards mid off.
On middle, clipped towards mid-wicket for a run.
Tom Curran is introduced into the attack.
On the stumps, worked against the spin to mid-wicket. A tidy start by Rashid.
Gives it a nice loop on off, Taylor drives it to covers.
Flatter but down the leg side, Guptill works it through square leg for a run.
A yorker, a loopy one. Guptill jams it out.
Floats it up on middle, driven back to the bowler.
Straightaway Taylor uses his feet and drives him down to long on for a run.
Time for spin! Adil Rashid to roll his arm over. Scott Styris mentioned in the pitch report that there won't be a lot of spin on this wicket. Let's see if the leggie does get any purchase.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Extra protection now for the bowlers as 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
A dot to end the Powerplay! A good one for England! Full outside off, Guptill leaves it.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! No stopping those! Trademark Guptill there! Nothing wrong with the delivery. Just ahead of a length around off, Guptill plants his front foot forward and drives it on the up and through covers for a boundary.
Lands it on a length in the zone outside off. Guptill does not fiddle with it.
Back of a length on off, Guptill keeps it out.
Another length ball outside off, left alone.
On the pads, flicks it in front of square. there is protection in the deep so it is only a single.
FOUR! Uppish but away from the fielder at mid on! Fuller on middle, Guptill lofts it over the bowler's head also holds his pose for the cameras later as the ball races to the fence.
Attacks the stumps this time. Guptill guides it towards point.
Once again in the avenue of apprehension. Guptill leaves it.
Another length ball angling away from the batsman. Guptill shoulders his arms to it.
Good length on off, defended solidly.
Attacks the stumps, Taylor defends it.

Short and cut away through point! It looked destined to go for a boundary but Moeen Ali had different ideas. He runs to his right from third man, dives and stops it just before it crosses the ropes. Two taken by the batsmen.
Shorter in length on off, Guptill guides it past point and down towards third man for a run.
Hits the length again around off, Guptill pushes it to covers.
Back of a length on off, Guptill defends it.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Length delivery on off, Taylor defends it. Just a run from the over, a good one by Willey.
Fuller on middle, driven towards mid on.
Another ball on the pads, Taylor misses the flick to get hit on the pads.
On middle, worked towards mid-wicket.
On a length around middle, Taylor tries to defend but it goes off the outer half towards point.
Down the leg side, Taylor misses the flick and the umpire signals a wide.
Good length on off, Taylor keeps it out.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! On the pads this time, Guptill lofts it over mid on for another boundary. A good over this one for New Zealand, 9 from it.

FOUR! This should break the shackles! Woakes this time bowls it a little fuller outside off, Guptill just puts his bat to it. Finds the gap between cover and mid off and the ball races away for a boundary.
Good length on off, Guptill is solid in defense.
Good leave! Another length ball closer to the off pole. Guptill plants his front foot forward and lets it be.
Full and swinging away. Guptill does not fiddle with it.
Fullish on middle, Taylor tries to drive but gets an inside edge through mid-wicket for a run.

Top stuff from England! Willey once again hits the length hard and attacks the stumps. Not a lot you can do with that delivery as Guptill defends it. Those wickets have not let New Zealand get off to a flier. The question here is though can they recover?
Excellent fielding! The English side have their tails up here! Length ball around off, Guptill pushes it towards covers where Morgan dives to his left and makes an excellent stop.
Fuller on middle, driven to mid on.
On a length slanting across the batsman who leaves it.
On the pads, worked towards deep square leg for a run.
Fullish on off, driven to mid on.
Fuller on off, driven to mid off. Another good over by Woakes comes to an end. His figures now read 2-1-2-2.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Errs in line and bowls it on the pads. Guptill works it through square leg for a brace.
Well bowled! Length ball around off, Guptill lunges forward and blocks it.
Ross Taylor who is fresh of a century walks out to the middle, replacing Chapman.

OUT! In the air... taken! Brilliant by Willey as he has made this skier look really easy. Woakes comes running in and bangs in a short one on middle. Chapman rocks back and tries to pull but is hurried into the shot. He gets a top edge towards square leg where Willey turns, runs back and takes an excellent catch with his hands outstretched. Never easy those as the ball was always going away from him due to the breeze. Not a good outing with the bat for Chapman on debut. England get their second and they are all pumped up. New Zealand in some trouble here.
Lands it on a length around off, Chapman defends it towards point.
Length on off, defended solidly.
Another full ball on the pads, Guptill goes to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
WIDE! Willey is getting some swing but he has not got it right. Full swinging into the batsman but down the leg side. Guptill misses his flick and the umpire signals a wide.
On the pads, Guptill misses out as he flicks it straight to short fine leg.
Another ball on the pads, Guptill misses the flick to get hit on the pads.
First run for Chapman in ODI cricket! This should settle his nerves a little. Length ball around off, Mark tries to defend but it takes the inside edge and rolls towards square leg for a run.
On the leg stump, Guptill works it around the corner for a run.

Lovely, lovely stuff from Woakes. He lands it on a length around off, angles it away from the batsman who pokes at it tentatively but gets beaten. End of a wicket maiden for Woakes. Excellent start by him.
Early nerves? Maybe! Full and outside off, a similar delivery to which Munro got out. Chapman goes after it but gets beaten.
Wide outside off, Chapman makes a good leave.
Mark Chapman, the debutant, wakjs out to the middle.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Woakes draws first blood! He bowls the sucker ball, a full ball outside off. Munro goes after it away from his body but only manages to get a faint outside edge to Buttler who takes it with ease. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Almost a replica of how Colin was dismissed in Hamilton. He is walking back as he bags another failure. An early wicket for England, just the start they wanted.
Back of a length on middle, defended.
Nicely timed but for no runs! On a length around off, Munro strokes it off the middle and on the up towards mid off. The fielder there dives to his right and saves a certain boundary for his team.
Chris Woakes will bowl with the second new ball.
A good finish to the over by Willey! On a length around off, shapes in a touch. Guptill defends it towards mid off. 6 from the first over.
This one slants across the batsman. Guptill watchfully makes a leave.
Length ball around off, swings in a touch. Guptill plants his front foot forward and defends it.
FOUR! First for the day! Poor ball by Willey on the pads, too easy for Guptill as he flicks it fine beating the man at short fine leg for a boundary.
Munro is off the mark now! A length ball on off, no swing for Willey. Colin taps it towards cover for a quick run.
Run straightaway! A very full ball outside off, Guptill reaches it out for it and drives it towards wide mid off, not of the middle but enough to get a run.

We are all set for the action to begin. The English players make their way out to the middle. Followed by the two dynamic openers, Colin Munro and Martin Guptill. The latter will be taking strike and he will be facing David Willey who will bowl with the first new ball. He has two slips in place. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Scott Styris says the pitch has a little bit of moisture in it. Further adds there is more grass covering on it. Informs it is the first day night game on this ground and the surface won't be changing much. Mentions he does not see the spinners getting a lot of help from the wicket. Ends by saying a lot of runs on offer for the batsmen.

New Zealand skipper, Tim Southee, starts by saying Williamson is not fit for the game today as he has a hamstring although not that major. Informs there are two changes, Lockie Ferguson comes in for Ish Sodhi and Mark Chapman will replace the regular captain. Mentions he too wanted to bowl first. Further adds they are well focused and is really excited to lead the side today.

England skipper, Eoin Morgan, opines it does look a soft wicket but they like chasing. Informs they are unchanged. Mentions if dew comes in, it will work in their favour. Further adds they have a lot of positives to take from the last game as it was a tight one against a strong New Zealand side. Ends by saying there is a bit of cross-breeze blowing across and wants to take the advantage of it.
TOSS - As expected no Kane Williamson for New Zealand and it is Tim Southee who walks out with Eoin Morgan for the toss. The latter calls it right and England elect to bowl.

The home side on the other hand, will look to win their 10th game in a row at home. They though, will have to do it without their permanent skipper, Kane Williamson, who will miss out due to an injury. Tim Southee will be the stand-in captain for them. Also, Mark Chapman might make his debut in this format as he was impressive in the T20I tri series recently and has also been in good form in the domestic circuit. It is overcast for now and there are some showers predicted later in the evening. Let us hope that it stays away. Will we see the hosts go 2-0 ahead or will the English side come back roaring? Stay tuned for the toss.

Hello and welcome to the second ODI between New Zealand and England. A nail-biter is what we witnessed in the opening encounter and we will be hoping for the same here today at Mount Maunganui. Have England recovered from the loss? They were sloppy on the field and a lot better is expected from them if they are to topple the hosts. It will be interesting to see if England make any changes to their eleven.
